scope.writer: pyramid (ADR-C030 minor-4; 2K sources fall back to the as-is base path)
scope.note: p50/p95 ratios compare tc_v7b_frame_decode(BASE_ONLY) of each source against plain V2 tc_frame_decode of a 1920×1080 packet on identical synthetic content; §6.3 targets are product goals (p50 ≤ 1.25×, p95 ≤ 1.50×). Bitrate = frame packet bytes × 8 × fps at the stated reference frame rate (intra-only codec, every frame is a keyframe); bpp is bits per 4:2:2 sample
